verdict.rationale: Plugging MCP servers in so the product can use their tools is the MCP-client (agent/host) role. OneDrive is a cloud file storage and sync service, not an AI agent or host that consumes external tools, so this axis is a category error for it. Nothing in the evidence shows OneDrive acting as an MCP client or hosting an agent that does; the evidence covers only file APIs, sharing, sync and versioning.
